sets.name: Button
sets.description: Primary and secondary button. State covers Default, Hover and Disabled. Leading and trailing icons are swappable; trailing is off by default. Every visual property binds to the Brand collection, so the button re-skins with the brand mode.

sets.name: Checkbox
sets.description: Checkbox with Unchecked / Checked / Indeterminate across Default, Hover and Disabled. Label is optional via a component property. All colour, size, radius and type bind to the Brand collection.

sets.name: Menu item
sets.description: Menu row. Single shows a leading icon; Multi embeds a Checkbox for multi-select. States: Default, Hover, Selected, Disabled. Bound to the Brand collection.

sets.name: Dropdown
sets.description: Dropdown trigger. Single shows the chosen value, Multi shows a selection count. Open flips the chevron and uses the focus border. Pair with Dropdown menu.

sets.name: Dropdown menu
sets.description: Multi-select menu surface: a Select all row, a divider, then Menu item instances. Swap rows or switch Mode on each item for single-select.
